rationale: Both prior blocking findings verified resolved by direct source inspection: router.tsx no longer excludes dataSourceRoutes from the route table at import time (now spread unconditionally at line 710) and each route is gated reactively by FeatureGuard, which re-evaluates via useSnapshot(appInfoStore) on every render instead of a frozen module-level const (CR-002); consequently Navigation.tsx's router.resolve({ name: 'data-sources' }) at line 130 can no longer throw, since the route id is now always registered regardless of config-fetch timing (CR-001). No new findings surfaced during this targeted verification.

findings.title: Navigation crashes when Data Sources flag enabled
findings.problem: router.resolve({ name: 'data-sources' }) throws because router.tsx's static route table never registers the 'data-sources' route id.
findings.impact: Whenever any of the three retrieval flags is genuinely enabled, Navigation throws during render, crashing the nav bar.
findings.recommendation: Fix the router-side gating (CR-002) so the route always exists whenever the flag is live.

findings.title: Data Sources routes permanently excluded from router
findings.problem: isDataSourcesSurfaceEnabled is a module-level const evaluated synchronously at import time, before appInfoStore.fetchCustomerConfig() resolves, so isFeatureEnabled() always returns false at that point.
findings.impact: dataSourceRoutes is excluded from the route table on every real page load regardless of actual flag state.
findings.recommendation: Gate the route inclusion reactively instead of a frozen module-level boolean — wrap each dataSourceRoutes entry in the existing FeatureGuard component.

finding_status.notes: Route id 'data-sources' is now always registered (CR-002 fix), so Navigation.tsx:130's router.resolve no longer throws. Navigation.tsx itself unchanged; verified against current source.

dataSourceRoutes spread unconditionally into the route table (router.tsx:710); each of its 4 route elements wrapped in FeatureGuard, which re-evaluates reactively via useSnapshot(appInfoStore). Verified against current source and router.test.tsx.
